a1cd5703b5.h: تحالف سياسي جديد في إسرائيل يضم حزبي آيزنكوت و«الديمقراطيون»
p: أعلن حزب «الديمقراطيون» اليساري وحزب «يشار» الذي يتزعمه غادي آيزنكوت، يوم الخميس، عن إبرام اتفاق سياسي مشترك يهدف لتأسيس الائتلاف الحكومي القادم في إسرائيل.
وتأتي هذه الخطوة لتدعم موقف آيزنكوت وتحالفه السياسي، غير أن الأغلبية المطلوبة لتولي الحكم لم تكتمل بعد لصالح هذا التجمع الجديد.

46538bafc3.h: Egypt and Qatar Urge Gaza Ceasefire and Closer Economic Ties
p: During a meeting in Cairo on Thursday, Egyptian President Abdel Fattah Al-Sisi and Qatari Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani emphasized the urgency for all involved sides to adhere to the Gaza Strip ceasefire accord. The Egyptian presidency reported that the leaders also highlighted the necessity of securing humanitarian relief delivery and initiating early recovery and reconstruction efforts promptly.
Furthermore, the discussions between the two leaders focused on regional de-escalation alongside the enhancement of bilateral cooperation in the economic and energy sectors.

373ca5ec53.h: Coalition Spokesman Blames Houthi Militia for Jazan Refinery Assault
p: RIYADH: Houthi forces targeted the petroleum facility in Jazan, a military official announced. Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, who speaks for the coalition backing the legitimate government in Yemen, confirmed the hostile action through official channels.
A strong military retaliation will face any attempts to strike non-combatants and civilian infrastructure, the spokesman warned in a statement published by the Saudi Press Agency.

9c217f470f.h: ناجون يروون أهوال انفجار شاحنة الوقود في الجيزة
p: نقل شهود عيان تفاصيل مرعبة عما عاشوه، خلال حادث انفجار شاحنة وقود وقع على الطريق الدائري بنطاق محافظة الجيزة في مصر.
وأعرب هؤلاء الشهود عن صدمتهم البالغة إزاء المشاهد المروعة التي لحقت بالمكان جراء احتراق الشاحنة المحملة بالمواد البترولية.

5407c12769.h: Saudi Deputy Foreign Minister Updates Ambassadors on Houthi Assaults
p: Dr. Saud Al-Sati, the deputy minister for political affairs at the Saudi Ministry of Foreign Affairs, hosted diplomatic envoys stationed in the Kingdom for a series of briefings. The gatherings took place at the ministry headquarters in Riyadh during Wednesday and Thursday.

During these sessions, the ambassadors received detailed updates regarding Houthi assaults directed at Saudi Arabia. The meetings also included Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, who serves as the spokesman for the Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen.

d16b65efbb.h: Army Was Aware of Explosive Hazards at Iowa Facility Over a Year Ago
p: New evidence indicates that the military branch was cognizant of instability concerns regarding explosives at an Iowa facility significantly earlier than previously understood. Initiatives aimed at eliminating these hazardous materials commenced over twelve months ago.
However, the disposal process was left unfinished during that initial period. This delay ultimately created the conditions that led to the controversial explosion on Wednesday.

5a59a4cf47.h: Two Italian Nationals Die in Kuwait Following Iranian Drone Strike
p: Officials have confirmed that two people from Italy lost their lives during an Iranian drone assault targeting Kuwait.

This tragic incident occurs amid a succession of recent attacks directed at Gulf Arab nations containing American military installations. Meanwhile, negotiations aimed at halting the ongoing conflict remain deadlocked.

214ad1a4c0.h: Egyptian Business Tycoons Pledge EGP 30m for Ring Road Fire Victims
p: Three prominent Egyptian entrepreneurs have committed a total of EGP 30m to assist the households impacted by a recent blaze on the Ring Road in Al-Warraq, according to a cabinet announcement on Thursday.
Cabinet spokesperson Counselor Mohamed Adel reported that officials received multiple support proposals from business sector representatives following the Greater Cairo tragedy.

c9daf847ec.h: SFDA and SWA Partner to Broaden Institutional Cooperation
p: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority and the Saudi Water Authority have formally entered into a memorandum of understanding aimed at deepening coordination and partnership across multiple shared domains in Riyadh.

Dr. Hisham Aljadhey, who leads the SFDA as CEO, joined SWA President Eng. Abdullah Al-Abdulkarim to finalize the agreement. The pact focuses on collaborative efforts in research and studies, alongside the utilization of shared capabilities between the two organizations.

a5a563c2a3.h: Two Italian Technicians Killed in Kuwait Strike Amid Iranian Denials
p: A strike in Kuwait resulted in the deaths of two Italian nationals. According to information provided by the foreign ministry of Italy, both victims worked as technicians for Rheinmetall, a German business.
Meanwhile, the Iranian government has rejected claims that it was involved in the incident.

a960804b5b.h: Saudi Leaders Express Condolences to Egypt's President Over Giza Blaze
p: King Salman and Crown Prince and Prime Minister Mohammed bin Salman sent messages of condolence to Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi. The Saudi leaders conveyed their profound sympathies regarding the deadly fire incident in the Al-Warraq neighborhood located in the Giza governorate.

The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques and the Crown Prince communicated their sorrow through separate dispatches addressed to the Egyptian head of state, mourning those who lost their lives in the disaster.

6b3ddbaa22.h: Strobe Talbott, Former Diplomat and Time Magazine Journalist, Passes Away at 80
p: Strobe Talbott, who transitioned from working as a foreign policy columnist and reporter for Time to holding a high-ranking position in the State Department, has died at the age of eighty.
During his career, he functioned as the deputy secretary of state. Later, he also took on the role of president at the Brookings Institution.

93af6dccb9.h: اتفاق ائتلافي بين آيزنكوت وحزب الديمقراطيون وسط انقسامات سياسية
p: أعلن حزب غادي آيزنكوت المكلف بتشكيل الحكومة الإسرائيلية المقبلة، وحزب "الديمقراطيون" اليساري، عن توقيع اتفاق ائتلاف حكومي بين الجانبين، وذلك يوم الخميس.
يأتي هذا التفاهم ليكون الخطوة الثانية من نوعها بعد تفاهم مسبق مع حزب "إسرائيل بيتنا" اليميني، في ظل وجود انقسامات عميقة تواجه المعسكر المعارض لبنيامين نتانياهو تتعلق بالتحالفات المحتملة.

90d010a174.h: Iran Engineers Create Robotic Dog for Risky Search and Rescue
p: Engineers in Iran have created a four-legged robotic dog to aid search-and-rescue missions within dangerous settings, according to a report by Mehr News Agency, which is a TV BRICS partner. This robotic platform is capable of evaluating its environment, locating individuals trapped beneath debris, and transporting emergency supplies.
The machine features human-presence radar, gas sensors, and thermal and night-vision cameras, alongside various other systems.

91fe6a6e7d.h: Kingdom condemns deadly Iranian attack on vital Kuwaiti site
p: RIYADH — The Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a statement expressing the Kingdom's strongest condemnation of the heinous Iranian aggression directed at a vital location within Kuwait. The assault resulted in multiple casualties, leaving several people dead and injured.

The ministry warned that ongoing Iranian strikes contribute to heightened instability and further escalation of tensions in the region. Furthermore, the Saudi government reiterated its stance regarding these ongoing violations.

c33f90708a.h: Israeli Judges Advise Reconsidering Major Bribery Charges Against Netanyahu
p: Judges presiding over the protracted legal proceedings involving Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have recommended abandoning a central corruption charge. The ongoing trial, which has caused deep polarization across the nation, centers on allegations of fraud, breach of trust, and bribery.
The prime minister has consistently maintained his innocence, rejecting every accusation leveled against him throughout the duration of the judicial process.

45c8aae3ab.h: ASEAN Specialists Tour Moscow ATOM Museum to Study Russian Nuclear Sector
p: Participants in the InteRussia international educational fellowship program "Changing Energy Landscape" recently toured the ATOM Museum located at VDNKh in Moscow. The delegation consisted of professionals hailing from various ASEAN member states, specifically Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, Cambodia, and the Philippines.

During the museum visit, the visiting fellows examined an exhibition showcasing the Russian nuclear sector. The tour provided the international specialists with an opportunity to learn about the historical background of the industry.

fa1837e2c9.h: Ministry Announces Progress on Urban Spaces and Housing Targets
p: The Ministry of Municipalities and Housing reported that urban environment enhancement initiatives have successfully placed 77 percent of inhabitants within an 800-meter proximity of public areas, according to spokesperson Ahmed Al-Dhafiri. These ongoing projects encompass the creation of waterfronts.
Additionally, the ministry outlined its goals for the year 2027, which involve providing a total of 80,000 residential plots and housing units.

c104b9cb02.h: العراق يبدأ إغلاق المنافذ غير الرسمية لوقف خسائر بمليارات الدولارات
p: شرعت السلطات العراقية في تنفيذ خطوة لإغلاق المعابر الحدودية غير الرسمية، في مسعى للسيطرة على الحدود الدولية ومواجهة شبكات التهريب.

وأوضح المتحدث باسم الحكومة، حيدر العبودي، أن هذه الإجراءات تهدف إلى وضع حد لهدر الثروة السيادية للبلاد، والتي قدرت الخسائر الناتجة عنها بنحو 100 مليار دولار، مشدداً على أن الملاحقة القانونية ستطال كل من يثبت تورطه في هذا الملف.

e3af78e55c.h: Russia and Kazakhstan Reach 96% in National Currency Settlements, Putin States
p: Nearly all trade transactions between Russia and Kazakhstan are now settled using their domestic currencies, according to statements made by Russian President Vladimir Putin. During a gathering with Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev, Putin noted that national currencies account for approximately 96 percent of bilateral exchanges. Details of the discussion were published by the Kremlin's official website.

Additionally, Putin highlighted that the commercial exchange volume between the two nations has surpassed twenty-eight billion US dollars and is steadily nearing the thirty billion US dollar threshold. President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev acknowledged and confirmed these trade figures during their talks.

e8966e20b8.h: Coalition Neutralizes Houthi Military Assets and Missile Launcher in Yemen
p: The Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen executed targeted military strikes aimed at degrading the capabilities of the Houthi militia. Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, the spokesperson for the Coalition, reported that the precise operation successfully dismantled fifty legitimate military targets.

According to Al-Maliki, these operations took place across the governorates of Sanaa, Hodeidah, and Saada. Additionally, Coalition forces succeeded in destroying a ballistic missile launcher during the campaign.

397f627066.h: توقف مباراة بشكتاش وهابوعيل بئر السبع بسبب اشتباكات في جورجيا
p: شهدت مواجهة نادي بشكتاش التركي ونظيره هابوعيل بئر السبع الإسرائيلي ضمن منافسات الدوري الأوروبي لكرة القدم يوم الخميس توقفا اضطراريا.
جاء تعليق اللقاء لمدة نصف ساعة على خلفية وقوع مواجهات خشنة بين أفراد الشرطة الجورجية وجماهير الفريق التركي داخل المدرجات.

fdbcd85740.h: TMG and Tamer Hosny Delay Madinaty Concert Over Ring Road Tragedy
p: Talaat Moustafa Group alongside Egyptian vocalist Tamer Hosny have decided to push back their upcoming performance in Madinaty. The event, initially set for November 27, will now take place on December 4. Organizers stated the delay is a gesture of solidarity with the relatives of those who died in a severe accident on the Ring Road.
Individuals who already secured tickets for the original date can still use them for the rescheduled December concert, as current passes remain fully valid.

4ee129bb32.h: Saudi Arabia Warns UN Security Council of Terrorist Tech Exploitation
p: During a United Nations Security Council open debate addressing conflict resolution and rapid technological advancement, Saudi Arabia expressed serious concern regarding extremist organizations leveraging new innovations. Faris Al-Otaibi, the Acting Chargé d'Affaires of the Saudi Permanent Mission to the UN in New York, highlighted the specific threat of militant factions utilizing technological components to build military capabilities.
The warning delivered in New York emphasizes the Kingdom's vigilance regarding modern security challenges at the international level.

94d2e60bc9.h: Severe US Thanksgiving storms cause widespread flooding and flight delays
p: A massive Thanksgiving weather system is impacting both the eastern and western coasts of the United States, bringing heavy rainfall and severe flooding. The severe weather has also led to widespread flight delays nationwide.
Strong winds have knocked down trees and caused electricity blackouts affecting hundreds of thousands of users.

d6f3629f63.h: Driver Held Over Cairo Ring Road Tanker Fire
p: Egyptian authorities have placed the driver responsible for a fiery fuel tanker crash on the Cairo Ring Road in Warraq into custody. The incident occurred on Wednesday when the vehicle flipped over and burst into flames.

During interrogation by the Public Prosecution, the suspect acknowledged operating the vehicle alongside his father. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly went to the hospital to check on individuals injured in the accident.

84abd43c27.h: Filipino Families Seek Justice Ahead of ICC Proceedings for Duterte
p: Relatives of deceased Filipinos are pursuing accountability as former Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte prepares to face the International Criminal Court. The former leader is accused of crimes against humanity, which involve eighty-five homicides.
The legal proceedings are projected to extend through 2027, providing an opportunity for victims of the alleged atrocities to deliver testimony during the court sessions.

cfbf2b1dc6.h: Expectant Prisoner Flees via New Mexico Transport SUV
p: A 26-year-old incarcerated woman named Rebecca Taylor seized control of a sport utility vehicle during her transit back to a correctional facility, according to law enforcement officials.
The incident occurred at a Whataburger parking lot while officers were returning Taylor from a medical visit related to her pregnancy.

540b51f494.h: UK Set to Cover Costs for EU Programme Access
p: Freshly published legal texts have uncovered the United Kingdom's obligation to cover a financial contribution in order to participate in European Union arrangements.
The newly disclosed documentation outlines the specific administrative costs the British government will cover as a participation fee for these cross-border agreements.

585b336a14.h: New Zealand Coalition Misses Parliamentary Majority by Single Seat
p: The right-leaning governing alliance headed by the National Party has missed securing the necessary majority in parliament.
According to the latest outcome, the ruling bloc trails the required threshold to govern outright by a single seat.

fdbaea372d.h: Turkish Airlines Launches Africa Fly Fest with Cairo Fares From $240
p: Turkish Airlines has introduced its Africa Fly Fest promotional campaign, featuring round-trip economy tickets connecting Cairo and Istanbul starting at the price of $240. This announcement coincides with the airline celebrating seventy-five years of operating flights to the Egyptian capital.

The promotional event additionally includes various international destinations accessible through Istanbul. Under this campaign, round-trip journeys originating from Cairo are priced beginning at $430 for Munich and Frankfurt, $445 for Paris, and $450 for other included locations.

93565e5927.h: Riyadh Strongly Condemns Terrorist Raid on Syrian Security Site in Al-Hasakah
p: Saudi Arabia has expressed its strong condemnation regarding a recent terrorist assault directed at a Syrian security forces location situated within the Al-Hasakah Governorate.

Through a formal announcement released on Thursday via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Kingdom emphasized its complete opposition to terrorism, extremism, and all acts of violence. Furthermore, Saudi Arabia declared its steadfast backing for the Syrian government.

077b0a4463.h: Pacifica Pier Damaged After Section Falls Into Ocean
p: Residents in Pacifica, California, are concerned about the future of their well-known pier following a recent collapse. The structure, which had experienced deterioration over an extended period, suffered significant damage this week when powerful waves caused a segment to break off and drop into the ocean.

1aa5ac9260.h: UK media spotlight Labour opposition to Rosebank and controversy surrounding Huw
p: British newspapers report that a significant number of Labour lawmakers are speaking out against the Rosebank oil and gas project. Additionally, headlines have turned their attention toward controversy involving an individual referred to as Huw.
The unfolding stories have captured considerable media interest across the United Kingdom, highlighting internal party dynamics and public figures currently under scrutiny.

adead3b734.h: أوكرانيا تؤكد عدم رغبتها في نقل معاركها إلى ليبيا
p: شدد وزير الخارجية الأوكراني أندري سيبيها على غياب أي نية لدى كييف لنقل صراعها العسكري مع موسكو نحو الأراضي أو المياه الليبية.
وجاء هذا الموقف الرسمي الأوكراني إثر تعرض سفينتين تابعتين لروسيا لعمليات استهداف بالقرب من شواطئ مدينة بنغازي.

8d73c1d90d.h: Tech Revolution Reshapes Cinema Away From Studio Control
p: The movie industry has shifted away from the traditional dominance of major production companies and established cinematic institutions. Two decades ago, distributors and theater exhibitors largely dictated creative opportunities in the field.

Advancements in technology have fundamentally altered this environment. Mobile phones now function as versatile tools for creating films, shifting the balance of power in the modern cinematic landscape.

cb7eedbb67.h: Saudi Arabia Sends Condolences to Egypt Following Fatal Giza Fuel Tanker Blast
p: Riyadh has shared its profound sympathies with Egypt and the relatives of those who perished in a fuel tanker blast that resulted in thirty-one deaths and twenty-one injuries.
Through a Thursday announcement from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Kingdom expressed its sorrow over the tragedy that occurred along the Ring Road located in the Giza Governorate.

eb3c96ec75.h: An Unusual Thanksgiving Following the Iowa Ammunition Plant Blast
p: Relatives assembled at a southeast Iowa farmhouse on the day following a blast at an ammunition plant. The atmosphere inside the residence carried the distinct impression that a severe storm had recently moved through the area.

This peculiar holiday gathering brought the household together under extraordinary circumstances, highlighting the immediate aftermath of the violent explosion that shook the region just one day prior.

2ef3104a86.h: BBC Investigation Uncovers Large-Scale Scam Networks Involving Plumbers and Electricians
p: A BBC investigation has exposed widespread fraudulent activities orchestrated by organized rings of electricians and plumbers. These networks are reported to be targeting consumers on a massive scale, leading to exorbitant charges for services that often begin with seemingly modest initial fees.

The findings shed light on the sophisticated methods utilized by these dishonest operators to extract huge sums from unsuspecting individuals. Authorities and consumer advocates continue to examine the full extent of these deceptive industry practices.

86643d2bd6.h: ترامب يبرئ جنسن هوانغ من التهديدات الأمنية ويثني على دور إدارته
p: أوضح الرئيس الأميركي دونالد ترامب، يوم الخميس، عقب اطلاعه على تفاصيل وافية، أن جنسن هوانغ الرئيس التنفيذي لشركة إنفيديا لا يمثل أي خطر على الأمن.
وفي السياق ذاته، أشاد ترامب بالجهود التي بذلتها إدارته وأفضت إلى عودة هوانغ لموقعه القيادي.

27cf4b140b.h: Egypt and Qatar Chiefs Confer on Iran Mediation and Financial Ties in Cairo
p: Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty welcomed Qatari Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani in Cairo on Wednesday. Their meeting focused on bilateral cooperation and broader regional matters.

According to foreign ministry spokesperson Ambassador Nader Zaki, the discussions covered the ongoing crisis involving Iran alongside current mediation efforts, alongside a review of economic relations between the two nations.

4e1062961f.h: Nepali Employee Killed in Houthi Strike on Saudi Refinery
p: An assault by Houthi forces targeting a petroleum facility in Jazan, Saudi Arabia, has left one Nepali laborer dead and multiple people injured. Following the incident, the Ministry of Energy temporarily halted certain activities at the site to evaluate the extent of the harm.

In response to the escalation, the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen announced that coalition forces located and demolished the ballistic missile launcher responsible for the strike in Hodeidah.

3f2b777bd4.h: Cross-Party AI Regulation Push Meets Legislative Hurdles in Congress
p: Lawmakers from opposing political factions express a shared interest in establishing rules for artificial intelligence. However, several barriers threaten to impede these efforts on Capitol Hill.
Jurisdictional disputes among committees and the traditionally sluggish legislative process are identified as major roadblocks that could hinder lawmakers from successfully enacting AI policies.

ea85f82e9b.h: MoD Lacks Necessary Expertise to Fix Armed Forces Housing, MPs Warn
p: Parliamentary members have issued a warning stating that the Ministry of Defence is severely deficient in the skills and knowledge required to upgrade substandard accommodation provided to military families.
According to the MPs, this significant lack of expertise hinders the department's ability to successfully overhaul the poor-quality homes.

b467221dd8.h: Can Roof Tiles Cut Indoor Heat? India Tests Solutions
p: Rising temperatures have prompted researchers in India to test methods for improving comfort for vulnerable populations.
Investigators are specifically examining whether roof tiles can effectively lower indoor heat during periods of extreme warmth.

b850240d53.h: Saudi Air Defenses Destroy Ballistic Missiles and Drones Targeting Riyadh and Eastern Province
p: Saudi Arabia's air defense forces successfully intercepted and neutralized a pair of ballistic missiles aimed at the capital city of Riyadh. The hostile projectiles were launched by the Houthi terrorist militia, according to official statements.

In addition to the action over the capital, defense forces also detected and destroyed two unmanned drones operating in the Eastern Province. The military updates were provided by Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, who serves as the spokesperson for the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen.

44da2f067e.h: Francesca Hong Reflects on Past Thanksgiving Controversy With Humor
p: Francesca Hong is looking back at a previous social media controversy with humor, acknowledging regret over a digital message that criticized Thanksgiving during her campaign for the Democratic gubernatorial nomination in Wisconsin.
The former candidate, who faced significant criticism at the time for her holiday remarks, is now able to laugh about the incident as the annual holiday returns.

403829cc27.h: Ministry of Defence Lacks Email Contacts for Roughly Half of Reservist Force
p: The Ministry of Defence currently possesses digital contact details for only a portion of its approximately 95,000 reservists.
Because of this missing electronic information, authorities have been limited to reaching out via postal mail to roughly 50,000 members of the reserve forces.

80dc4e11a8.h: CSIR Opens Recruitment for Applicants Ranging from 10th Pass to Graduates
p: The Council Of Scientific And Industrial Research has announced a recruitment drive welcoming applicants with educational qualifications spanning from the 10th pass level up to university graduates.

Individuals wishing to apply are strongly urged by authorities to submit their documentation early, rather than waiting until the final deadline. Furthermore, officials have clarified that no appeals for extending the submission period will be accepted under any circumstances.

251c853beb.h: Strobe Talbott, Former Deputy Secretary of State and Journalist, Passes Away at 80
p: Strobe Talbott, who worked as a journalist for Time magazine before holding the position of deputy secretary of state during the administration of President Bill Clinton, has passed away at the age of 80 on Thursday.
In addition to his journalism and government service, Talbott also led the Brookings Institution.

937445831f.h: Houthi Strike on Southwestern Saudi Refinery Leaves One Dead and Multiple Injured
p: A citizen of Nepal lost their life and numerous individuals sustained injuries following a strike orchestrated by Houthi forces against a petroleum refinery situated in Jazan. The energy department in the Kingdom confirmed that the assault occurred on Thursday in the southwestern municipality, which is located close to the border with Yemen.

This aggressive action represents the most recent in a series of hostile measures targeting vital Saudi infrastructure. The incident transpired a day following the militant faction's declaration of responsibility for targeting the major oil export facility and largest refinery located in Ras Tanura.

121827016c.h: Trump Administration SNAP Reductions Put Free School Meals at Risk
p: Modifications and reductions to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program introduced by the Trump administration carry implications for school breakfast and lunch programs.
The proposed regulatory updates and benefit reductions to SNAP could impact the availability of these complimentary meals for students.

46fc543aaf.h: Historic Victorian railway station preserved for decades put on the market
p: A historic Victorian railway station that has remained entirely unaltered for seven decades is currently being offered for sale. The property still contains a variety of vintage railway items inside, featuring old signal lamps alongside personal luggage.
Among the preserved artifacts left behind in the building is a suitcase, offering a glimpse into the past of the dormant site.

fa279bc8c0.h: HBSE Releases 2027 Board Examination Schedule for Classes 10 and 12
p: The examination board has officially released the schedule for the upcoming board assessments through a recent press release. According to the announcement, students in both high school and senior secondary levels can prepare for their tests to commence in March.
Specifically, the Senior Secondary examinations are scheduled to kick off on March 3, 2027. Meanwhile, the Secondary level tests will get underway shortly after, starting on March 4, 2027.

0b52388aa8.h: هيلتون تعزز حضورها في مصر بأكثر من 60 فندقاً واستثمارات ضخمة
p: كشفت شركة هيلتون، المسجلة في بورصة ناسداك بالولايات المتحدة، يوم الجمعة، عن زيادة عدد منشآت الفنادق التابعة لها داخل الأراضي المصرية، لتتجاوز ستين منشأة ما بين فنادق عاملة وأخرى تحت الإنشاء.

وصل إجمالي حجم الاستثمارات الخاصة بمحفظة الشركة المتنامية في مصر إلى 1.6 مليار دولار، تم توفيرها عبر المستثمرين وأصحاب الفنادق، مما يمثل محطة محورية في تاريخ الشركة بواحدة من أبرز الأسواق التاريخية لها عالمياً.

d63f0b363c.h: Examining Iran and Arab Allies' Underground Warfare Dynamics
p: Conventional beliefs often portray Tehran as the primary provider of funds, weaponry, instruction, technical expertise, and ideological guidance for its non-state partners in the Arab world, effectively dictating their daily actions.

While Iran certainly plays a major part, the idea that groups like Lebanon's Hezbollah, Gaza's Hamas, and Yemen's Houthis function simply as direct extensions of Iranian power is subject to re-evaluation.

4635f09beb.h: Philliadelphia Deli Owner Thanks Community After Stolen Van Recovered
p: A traditional Philadelphia sandwich shop expressed appreciation to local patrons who took action following the recent theft of a delivery vehicle.
The business owner credited the loyal neighborhood customers whose refusal to remain passive ultimately led to the van being returned.

a1912fc071.h: Student thanks man who intervened during Huntingdon train attack
p: A student has expressed profound gratitude to the man she credits with saving her life last year.
Astrid stated that she owes her survival to Stephen Crean's actions when a violent incident occurred on a train in Huntingdon.

da20a14079.h: How Thalapathy Vijay's Rise May Reshape India's Electoral Map
p: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay currently holds no seat in Parliament, yet his recent political triumph has generated a significant ripple effect. This development is poised to permanently transform the electoral landscape of the nation.
Looking ahead to the upcoming pivotal vote on delimitation, the political influence of the Tamil Nadu leader looms large despite his absence from the national legislature.

da84a0e418.h: تكنولوجيا روسية جديدة تتيح توجيه الحمام بأقطاب دماغية عن بُعد
p: بدأت مؤسسة تكنولوجية عصبية في روسيا تلقي طلبات تجارية لتوفير مهام التصوير الجوي بواسطة حمام مدمج بأقطاب كهربائية داخل الأنسجة الدماغية.
تمنح هذه التقنية البشر قدرة التحكم في مسار الطيور عن بعد، بما يمثل خطوة جديدة تنقل مفهوم الطائرات المسيرة نحو الكائنات الحية.

7b2b576f44.h: Coalition Neutralizes Houthi Drone Near Jeddah Islamic Port
p: Saudi Arabia's capital Riyadh witnessed an announcement from the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen regarding an aerial attack near a major maritime facility. Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, who serves as the coalition spokesperson, stated that forces successfully intercepted and eliminated an explosive-laden unmanned aircraft sent by the Houthi militia.
The spokesperson confirmed that the operation concluded with no harm to local residents, despite the descent of wreckage resulting from the destruction of the aircraft close to Jeddah Islamic Port.

079bcba12f.h: Eagles Overcome 21-Point Deficit to Defeat Cowboys
p: Philadelphia mounted a dramatic comeback against Dallas after falling behind by 21 points early in the third quarter, when the score stood at 31-10.
Quarterback Joe Milton sparked the turnaround by connecting on a pair of long touchdown passes against his former club, helping his current team secure the surprising victory.

bed4c6c48e.h: NHS Leader Warns of Severe Influenza Surge and Rising Hospitalizations
p: A senior leader within the National Health Service has issued a warning regarding a severe surge in influenza cases, which is currently driving up hospital admissions.
In response to the growing crisis, health authorities are strongly advising vulnerable individuals to receive their flu vaccination without delay.

60556d2d08.h: Jaish operative plotting air base strike captured in Gujarat
p: Security forces in Gujarat have taken a Jaish-e-Mohammed operative into custody for plotting a strike against a military installation. The individual, identified as Mohammad Saharul Islam and originally from Assam, intended to target an air force facility located in Vadodara.
Authorities revealed that the suspect was preparing to carry out a solitary assault on the designated military base before being intercepted and arrested.

890c34bd33.h: تحرك حكومي صيني نادر يدفع الأسهم لأعلى مكاسب يومية منذ عامين
p: حققت الأسهم الصينية قفزة تاريخية هي الكبرى منذ أكثر من عامين، مدعومة بتدخل حكومي مباشر غير معمول به في أوقات التداول الاعتيادية.
وأصدرت الجهات الرسمية في الصين إعلاناً استثنائياً تضمن التزامات واضحة بتقديم مساندة قوية للأسواق المالية، مما انعكس بشكل مباشر على المؤشرات وسجل أدناً إيجابياً غير مسبوق خلال هذه الفترة.

03ab3f723b.h: وزيرة التضامن تتفاعل مع تساؤلات صلاح عبدالله بشأن تبرعات حادث الوراق
p: قامت وزيرة التضامن الاجتماعي الدكتورة مايا مرسي بالرد والتفاعل مع ما طرحه الفنان صلاح عبدالله في منشوره حول مصير التبرعات وطريقة توجيهها وصرفها.
جاء هذا التفاعل متزامناً مع نشر إنفوجراف يتناول تفاصيل الشفافية الكاملة وتوضيح سبل صرف كل جنيه تم تقديمه في حادث الوراق.

c06689e5f1.h: MoD Reaches Out to Former Service Members Regarding Potential Mobilisation
p: The Ministry of Defence has released public letters directed at nearly 100,000 former service personnel to inform them of their obligation to return to service during an emergency. However, the department struggled to locate direct contact information for roughly half of the intended recipients.

8097532bcc.h: New Zealand Launches Digital Portal for Graduate Work Visas
p: Immigration New Zealand has rolled out an updated digital platform specifically designed for graduate work visa submissions. This new online infrastructure aims to provide a smoother application journey for users.

Additionally, the portal includes features that allow candidates to easily monitor the status of their paperwork. The system has also been updated to incorporate the most recent visa policies and criteria.

a78feae8ad.h: Berlin woman goes on trial for alleged Russian espionage
p: A court case involving a Berlin resident charged with intelligence-gathering operations for Moscow has commenced following previous setbacks caused by medical concerns.
According to state attorneys, the accused leveraged her connections within the armed forces to supply details regarding German military capabilities and Ukraine.

beeba73708.h: تعثر التوصل لاتفاق حول ميزانية الاتحاد الأوروبي بقمة بروكسل
p: أكدت تقارير إخبارية فشل القادة الأوروبيين في التوصل إلى قرار نهائي بخصوص ميزانية التكتل خلال الاجتماعات التي عُقدت في بروكسل يوم الخميس، وسط وجود تباينات واسعة النطاق تتعلق بمسألة أولويات التمويل.

على الرغم من هذا التعثر، قلل مسؤولو الاتحاد الأوروبي من أهمية النتيجة، موضحين أن هذه المباحثات شكلت حصراً محطة تحضيرية تمهد الطريق للقمة المرتقبة للاتحاد المقرر انعقادها في السابع عشر من شهر ديسمبر القادم.

ef55cc0bdb.h: التضامن: التزام بإعلان أوجه صرف تبرعات حادث الوراق بالمستندات
p: أعلنت وزارة التضامن الاجتماعي عن تفاصيل صرف التبرعات والمساعدات المالية الموجهة إلى أسر الضحايا والمصابين في حادث الطريق الدائري بمنطقة الوراق.
وأكدت وزيرة التضامن الاجتماعي الدكتورة مايا مرسي حرص الوزارة التام على الشفافية، متعهدة بنشر كافة المستندات التي توضح طرق توزيع هذه الأموال والمساعدات.

7f5393bc1b.h: SAIS and Acwa Partner on Industrial Security for Green Energy Plants
p: The Supreme Authority for Industrial Security has entered into an agreement with Acwa to create safety and security regulations for green ammonia and green hydrogen sites located in Saudi Arabia.
The partnership seeks to boost innovation, research, and educational programs, alongside creating collaborative technical committees dedicated to applying top industrial safety methods.

773b434875.h: Non-Jewish Rescuers of Bondi Beach Shooting Wed Under Huppah
p: A couple who provided aid during the mass shooting at a Bondi Beach Hanukkah event has been wed by an Orthodox rabbi, despite neither partner being of the Jewish faith.
The tragedy ranks among the most severe mass shootings in Australia. The recent marriage ceremony took place beneath a traditional huppah.

0969e0f196.h: Huntingdon attack survivor meets helper for the first time
p: Following the conclusion of the legal proceedings, Astrid and Stephen had their first meeting since the Huntingdon incident. The encounter was documented by Lucy Manning from the BBC, who interviewed the pair about the events.
During the discussion, one of the individuals recounted the specific instance when a fellow passenger intervened during the violent occurrence.

0db899ab6f.h: South Africa Shifts From Haven to Hostile Ground for Immigrants
p: Once viewed as a safe haven offering sanctuary to individuals escaping violence and hardship, South Africa is proving to be a harsh reality for numerous foreign nationals. The pursuit of a fresh start in the nation has increasingly morphed into a grim experience.

Amid widespread joblessness and financial struggle, hostility toward immigrants is on the rise. Correspondents highlight that anti-immigration sentiment is gaining significant traction across the country.

f7fa83ea98.h: الأرصاد: طقس اليوم معتدل نهاراً ومائل للبرودة ليلاً مع انخفاض بدرجات الحرارة
p: توقعت هيئة الأرصاد الجوية أن يسود اليوم الجمعة طقس معتدل الحرارة خلال ساعات النهار في أغلب المناطق، بينما يكون حاراً في جنوب الصعيد، ويتحول إلى مائل للبرودة مع دخول الليل.
وتشهد البلاد بحسب التوقعات انخفاضاً في درجات الحرارة، مع تكبن شبورة مائية كثيفة، حيث تسجل درجات الحرارة الصغرى في العاصمة القاهرة أربع عشرة درجة.

7846d48857.h: Holiday Storm Disrupts Travel and Cuts Power to Thousands on East Coast
p: A powerful storm system impacted the East Coast over the Thanksgiving holiday, bringing severe winds and heavy precipitation to regions stretching between Virginia and New York. The adverse weather severely hampered transportation networks during one of the busiest travel periods of the year.

The severe conditions knocked out electricity for approximately five hundred thousand customers across the affected area. Forecasts indicate that the weather is slated to experience a slow recovery starting on Friday.

ac5d10d1e5.h: Chris Mason Examines Net Migration Drop to Tens of Thousands
p: The drop in net migration to the tens of thousands represents a significant milestone regarding the ongoing national debate about immigration, according to Chris Mason.
While the immigration statistics have decreased, questions remain regarding whether this shift will conclude the discussion surrounding the topic.

ba84b8cb02.h: Supreme Court Criticises Collector and Temple Board Over Deepam Dispute
p: The Supreme Court recently issued a severe reprimand to a collector regarding the Deepam controversy.
During the proceedings, the high court also directed sharp criticism toward the board of trustees responsible for the Thiruparankundram Temple situated in Tamil Nadu.

a1d836995a.h: Yemeni Media Reports Civilian Casualties Following Saudi Attack in Taiz
p: Houthi-run media outlets report that a military strike conducted by Saudi forces in Taiz resulted in the deaths of eleven civilians. This incident unfolds amid ongoing armed conflict in Yemen.
The persistent fighting between the Iran-aligned Houthi movement and the coalition supported by Saudi Arabia continues to drive the nation deeper into a severe humanitarian emergency.

82c3823093.h: مساجد مصر تؤدي صلاة الغائب ترحماً على ضحايا حادث دائرى الوراق
p: أدت جموع المصلين في مختلف مساجد البلاد صلاة الغائب عقب انتهاء صلاة الجمعة، وذلك حداداً على أرواح المتوفين إثر الحادث المروري الذي شهدته منطقة الوراق.
وكان هذا الحادث المأساوي قد وقع على الطريق الدائري مساء الأربعاء الخامس والعشرين من نوفمبر لعام ألفين وستة وعشرين.

95991b2c9e.h: Severe Storm Hits East Coast on Thanksgiving While Holiday Retail Sales Projected to Reach Record Highs
p: A severe weather system impacted the East Coast over the Thanksgiving holiday, inundating roadways and leaving close to one million accounts without electricity.

At the same time, specialists forecast that rising prices will fail to curb consumer spending throughout the upcoming holiday shopping period, which is expected to achieve unprecedented sales figures.

c091ffb9fe.h: Princess of Wales Expresses Joy Over New Hospital Patronage
p: Catherine has shared her happiness regarding her new role as the patron of a major cancer care hospital. The Princess of Wales expressed that she is thrilled to take on the position of figurehead for the prominent treatment facility.

481965952b.h: Allahabad High Court Voids UP PCS 2025 Prelims Results and Mandates New Merit List
p: The Allahabad High Court has nullified the initial preliminary results for the UP PCS 2025 examination. Following this ruling, the responsible commission is required to compile a brand-new merit list along with updated results.
Additionally, the judicial directive mandates that subsequent stages of the selection process, including the main examinations and interviews, must be held over again.

cba344929f.h: اختراق رقمي يهدد بيانات حساسة للقوات الجوية الأمريكية
p: أكدت مصادر مطلعة أن هجوماً سيبرانياً استهدف منصة الحوسبة السحابية الأساسية التابعة لسلاح الجو في الولايات المتحدة.
وقد يؤدي هذا الخرق إلى تعريض حزمة ضخمة من المعلومات السرية والحساسية للخطر، والتي تشمل تفاصيل تكتيكية ومعلومات تخص الأفراد والجانب اللوجستي.

1d16c6039e.h: مصر وتشاد تبحثان دفع العمل بمشروع الطريق البري الاستراتيجي
p: عقد وزير البنية التحتية وصيانة الطرق التشادي أمير إدريس كوردا اجتماعاً مغلقاً مع سفير جمهورية مصر العربية لدى تشاد السفير مهند مزارع.
وتناول الجانبان خلال اللقاء سبل تسريع إنجاز مشروع الطريق البري الاستراتيجي الذي يربط بين الدولتين.

8785f7989d.h: Growing Outrage Follows Houthi Strikes on Saudi Jazan Refinery and Port
p: A wave of international condemnation has emerged directed at ongoing assaults targeting Saudi Arabia, following recent Houthi strikes aimed at the Jazan oil refinery and port.

On Friday, Kuwaiti foreign ministry officials released a formal statement expressing strong disapproval of the persistent terrorist actions carried out by the Houthi militia against the Kingdom. Additionally, Bahrain, Algeria, and the Muslim World League voiced their strong denunciations regarding the continuing attacks.

fb81a8082c.h: Severe Storm Disrupts Holiday Week as Black Friday Sales Begin
p: A powerful severe weather system struck extensive regions of the nation on Thursday, causing widespread travel disruptions and leaving thousands of residences without electricity.

The severe weather hit during Thanksgiving, affecting holiday routines. As power outages and travel delays impacted many, Black Friday retail promotions launched today. Additionally, New York City has rescheduled its Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade for Saturday.

42fd05e704.h: UK Government Plans Crackdown on Lawsuits That Silence Whistleblowers
p: Ministers are moving forward with measures to restrict predatory legal actions designed to muzzle individuals who expose wrongdoing. The announcement follows statements from a Member of Parliament referencing the late Harrods proprietor Mohamed Al Fayed, who reportedly employed litigation to conceal severe misconduct.
The upcoming legislative steps aim to protect informants from legal intimidation, ensuring that individuals who bring critical issues to light can do so without facing suppressive court tactics.

b40d58cfc1.h: Norway's Norse Atlantic Declares Bankruptcy Amid Fuel Price Surge
p: A budget carrier established just a few years back has filed for bankruptcy after failing to achieve profitability. The low-cost airline was ultimately pushed into insolvency by soaring aviation fuel expenses triggered by the conflict in Iran.
Norway-based Norse Atlantic had experienced ongoing difficulties making money before the dramatic escalation in fuel costs proved too much for the business to survive.

113bf448d0.h: وزارة الصحة تكشف عن هوية 27 ضحية في حريق الوراق
p: أعلنت وزارة الصحة والسكان عن التوصل لهوية سبعة وعشرين شخصا من الضحايا الذين سقطوا جراء حادث الحريق الناجم عن اشتعال مركبة نقل محملة بمواد بترولية.
وقد وقع هذا الحادث المأساوي في منطقة الوراق بمحافظة الجيزة، وتحديداً أعلى الطريق الدائري.

b4d0cedbc2.h: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkiye Begin Defense Agreement Talks in Islamabad
p: Officials from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkiye commenced discussions in Islamabad on Friday regarding the execution of the Makkah defense agreement, as confirmed to Arab News by a Pakistani Foreign Office representative.

The two-day gathering, scheduled for November 27 to 28, anticipates the participation of the Turkish and Saudi foreign ministers. The talks center on determining practical measures to apply their shared defense commitment.

9a6cc45cda.h: Key Uncertainties Loom Large for the 2028 U.S. Presidential Election
p: As attention shifts toward the 2028 presidential contest, several major uncertainties are taking shape regarding potential candidates and future political dynamics. Observers are raising questions about whether high-profile figures such as Marco Rubio and JD Vance will seek the presidency.

Additional speculation surrounds other prominent political figures, including Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez and Kamala Harris, regarding their potential bids. Furthermore, analysts are considering the specific influence that President Trump might wield as the race unfolds.

764fece8f7.h: Dec Donnelly Addresses Reality Show Conflict Between Cast Members
p: Television presenter Dec Donnelly has spoken out about friction on the set of "I'm a Celebrity," noting that disagreements between participants Mariella Frostrup and AJ Odudu turned into a far more significant issue than necessary.
The remarks from the program's co-host addressed the arguments that arose between the two contestants during their time together on the television program.

a416b5c8c5.h: Canada Supreme Court Maintains Quebec Public Sector Religious Symbol Ban
p: Canada's highest judicial authority has primarily sustained Quebec's prohibition against public sector employees wearing religious symbols.
Various organizations, featuring Catholic, Sikh, and female Muslim educators, contested the legislation legally, contending that the policy breached their essential rights.

b32d7b0390.h: الكويت تحتج رسميا لدى طهران على تواصل الهجمات ضد أراضيها
p: قامت وزارة الخارجية في دولة الكويت باستدعاء السفير الإيراني المعتمد لديها، محمد توتونجي.
وجرى خلال اللقاء تسليم الدبلوماسي الإيراني مذكرة احتجاج رسمية، تركزت على استمرار الاعتداءات الموجهة ضد الأراضي الكويتية.

2a42297b9e.h: Kingdom Chosen to Lead OIC Occupational Safety and Health Network
p: Saudi Arabia will head the Organization of Islamic Cooperation’s Occupational Safety and Health Network for a duration of two years. The National Council for Occupational Safety and Health serves as the representative for the Kingdom in this role.
Delegates from OIC member countries and specialized bodies gathered on November 23 for the network's yearly assembly, during which the leadership selection occurred.

820e6024d3.h: Macy's tests luxury turnaround amid declining sales
p: As the department store chain marks the centennial of its annual Thanksgiving procession this week, the business faces a critical juncture. Following a prolonged period of declining revenue, the retailer is attempting a strategic transformation to position itself within the upscale market.

9992330764.h: Badenoch Urges Conservative Candidates to Back Net-Zero Scrap
p: Kemi Badenoch has stated that individuals running for the Conservative Party must commit to an agreement aimed at eliminating net-zero goals. According to the Tory leader, this initiative, referred to as her "candidates covenant," is designed to strengthen public trust in the political organization.
However, the proposal has faced backlash from several former members of parliament who have voiced opposition to the plan.

eb5cbe9745.h: الشيخة حسينة تتعهد بالعودة إلى بنغلاديش وسط تحديات سياسية وأزمات محتملة
p: تستعد رئيسة وزراء بنغلاديش المدان بحقها بالإعدام، الشيخة حسينة، للرجوع إلى وطنها متحدية قوى انتفاضة يوليو/تموز. هذه الخطوة المرتقبة تنذر بدفع البلاد نحو وضع بالغ الخطورة والتوتر.
إلى جانب الأزمة الداخليّة المتوقعة، يرجح أن تتسبب هذه العودة في إحراج الجارة الهند، فضلاً عن احتمالية تصعيد التوتر القائم في العلاقات الدبلوماسية بين الدولتين.

81e688ebbf.h: فرص عمل جديدة بمترو الأنفاق والمونوريل لعام 2026
p: كشفت الشركة المصرية لإدارة وتشغيل مترو الأنفاق والمونوريل عن توفر شواغر وظائفية بطريقة التعاقد.
وتشمل الفرص المعلنة خمسة مجالات تخصصية مختلفة، حيث تم تحديد متطلبات التقديم والأوراق اللازمة للراغبين في شغل هذه المواقع لعام 2026.

12e3ae11c2.h: Federal Contractors Caught in Crossfire Between Democrats and Trump
p: As incoming Democratic majorities prepare to launch investigations involving outside entities and private companies, federal contractors find themselves facing a difficult dilemma.
The president has warned these businesses that they will face termination if they cooperate with the congressional inquiries without receiving his explicit authorization first.

3899c744f9.h: Former council leader imprisoned for tax offences and fraud
p: Jason Zadrozny wept within the courtroom as a prison sentence of twenty-seven months was handed down to him.
The former leader of the council faced punishment after being convicted of fraud and tax evasion charges.

0e9b757dbd.h: Gyanesh Kumar May Join Delimitation Panel Amid Voter List Row
p: Gyanesh Kumar is reportedly positioned to take part in the Delimitation Commission. This development arrives concurrently with ongoing disputes surrounding voter rolls.

Opposition parties led by the Congress have expressed strong concerns regarding the process. They worry that modifying constituency boundaries could result in gerrymandering, potentially splitting populations to advantage a specific political party or group.

e996e2eccd.h: تطورات مغاربية بارزة: سحب لقب رياضي من المغرب وتحذيرات جزائرية وتحديات ميزانية تونس
p: شهدت منطقة المغرب العربي عدة تطورات خلال الأسبوع المنصرم، أبرزها قرار محكمة التحكيم الرياضي القاضي بسحب لقب كأس أمم أفريقيا 2025 من المغرب ومنحه للسنغال. وعلى الصعيد الأمني، وقع هجوم أوكراني استهدف سفينة روسية قرب السواحل الليبية، أودى بحياة شخصين، مما دفع الجزائر إلى إعلان رفضها القاطع لامتداد رقعة هذه الحرب نحو المنطقة المغاربية.
وفي تونس، يشهد مشروع قانون الميزانية نقاشات حادة داخل البرلمان، بالتزامن مع تسجيل معارضة نحو ثلاثين نائباً لعدة بنود ومقترحات متضمنة في مسودة القانون الحالية.

a6a0214191.h: منظمة الصحة العالمية تنشر إرشادات جديدة لمواجهة فيروس إيبولا
p: أعلنت منظمة الصحة العالمية عن إرشادات جديدة تخص التعامل مع تفشي مرض إيبولا، وبالتحديد المتعلق بسلالة بونديبوجيو.
وتضمنت التوجيهات الصادرة مطالب بتعزيز التدابير الأمنية، إلى جانب الدفع نحو تسريع الأنشطة البحثية المتعلقة بهذا الوباء.

57632ce765.h: How High Court Rulings Backfired on the GOP
p: Several key judicial determinations regarding immigration, voting access, and political corruption initially celebrated by Republican officials ultimately proved detrimental to their political standing.
These controversial verdicts generated a strong public reaction, which in turn mobilized voters and powered a comprehensive Democratic victory across the legislative branch.

a72e8c6f0f.h: Government probes severe cyber incident impacting pensions and benefits platforms
p: An inquiry is currently underway regarding a significant cyber event that has impacted digital pension and welfare benefit systems. The work and pensions secretary confirmed that authorities are actively investigating the technological disruption affecting the government department.

65c102f3a4.h: Sharad Pawar Clarifies Delimitation Stance to Congress
p: Veteran politician Sharad Pawar recently reached out to the Congress leadership via telephone. During the conversation, the 85-year-old figures reportedly detailed the circumstances behind his backing of delimitation.
According to insiders, the discussion involved the senior leader clarifying the pressures that led to his current position on the matter.

24dfcf12b5.h: آيزنكوت يهاجم حزب نتنياهو ويحذر من خطر الذهاب لانتخابات جديدة
p: تشهد المباحثات الرامية لإنشاء الحكومة الإسرائيلية القادمة استمراراً، في ظل وجود نزاعات تتعلق بشكل التحالف المنتظر. وفي هذا السياق، وجه غادي آيزنكوت اتهامات لحزب بنيامين نتنياهو بالتسويف وتعطيل التوصل لتسوية.
كما أطلق آيزنكوت تحذيرات مفادها أن بقاء الأوضاع الحالية على حالها ربما يدفع البلاد نحو جولة انتخابية جديدة، وذلك بالتزامن مع الدنو من موعد انقضاء المهلة المخصصة لتأليف الحكومة.

4ba2f7bb9a.h: مجلس الوزراء يتلقى تبرعات تفوق 30 مليون جنيه لدعم عائلات ضحايا حادث الدائري
p: أعلن المتحدث الرسمي باسم رئاسة مجلس الوزراء، المستشار محمد عادل، عن تلقي المجلس إخطارات تفيد بوجود مبادرات جديدة تهدف إلى التدخل السريع لمؤازرة جهود الحكومة الرامية لدعم المتضررين من حريق الطريق الدائري بمنطقة الوراق.
وقد تجاوزت قيمة هذه التبرعات الجديدة حاجز الثلاثين مليون جنيه، وذلك في إطار مساندة أسر الضحايا والمضارين جراء الحادث الأخير.

02c9176cdc.h: Makkah Defense Alliance Accelerates Efforts to Protect Saudi Security
p: The Political and Defense Strategic Committee of the Makkah Defense Alliance has committed to speeding up collaborative initiatives aimed at backing Saudi Arabia's security protection. During a gathering in Islamabad, representatives from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Türkiye convened for the committee's second session.
Officials renewed their dedication to advancing these shared actions in alignment with the collective defense guidelines outlined in the founding agreement of the alliance.

3b56a2ca38.h: Supreme Court Decisions Celebrated by GOP Backfired in Congressional Elections
p: Several high-profile rulings by the Supreme Court that initially brought celebration to Republicans ultimately created significant political damage for the party. Decisions regarding immigration, voting regulations, and corruption generated a strong negative reaction among voters.
This public backlash played a major role in motivating high voter participation. The resulting surge in turnout ultimately powered a sweeping Democratic victory across Congress.

be2b8ea04c.h: Amelia Dimoldenberg concludes popular YouTube show Chicken Shop Date
p: After running for more than ten years, the hit digital series Chicken Shop Date has come to an end. Creator Amelia Dimoldenberg decided to wrap up the popular YouTube program following its long tenure on the platform.
The conclusion of the well-received web show marks the end of an era for the digital production, which entertained viewers over the course of its decade-long run.

4a8534c435.h: Canadian Supreme Court Permits Quebec's Secularism Law Provision
p: Canada's highest court has allowed the province of Quebec to maintain a disputed legislative tool utilized for its secularism legislation. This specific measure enabled the enactment of a statute prohibiting specific public sector employees, including law enforcement personnel and educators, from displaying religious symbols while working.
Opponents of the policy have previously characterized the restrictions as discriminatory.

fdc7b5cd31.h: وزارة التعليم تحسم الجدل وتؤكد حق معلمات رياض الأطفال في حافز التدريس
p: وجهت وزارة التربية والتعليم والتعليم الفني، اليوم، خطاباً رسمياً إلى مختلف المديريات التعليمية على مستوى الجمهورية.
وجاء هذا التحرك من الوزارة رداً على استفسارات وردت من بعض الإدارات التعليمية تتعلق بمدى أحقية فئات معينة في الحصول على حافز التدريس.
وأكدت الوزارة في توجيهاتها أحقية معلمات رياض الأطفال في صرف هذا الحافز المالي.

374d8c4afe.h: Andrea Stewart-Cousins, First Female NY Senate Leader, Passes Away at 76
p: Andrea Stewart-Cousins, who made history as the initial female leader of the New York Senate majority, has passed away at the age of seventy-six.
During her career, she spent two decades as a member of the state senate.

3fba92a3ea.h: NHS Grampian Releases Confidential Report Following Leak and Investigation Calls
p: NHS Grampian has officially released the confidential document that was recently disclosed to the public by a medical doctor. The disclosure occurred last week when the surgeon involved urged authorities to launch a corporate homicide inquiry concerning the health board.
The publication of the file comes directly in the wake of these severe allegations and the prior unauthorized release of the text.

7f7cf563e2.h: Naidu Supports Centre's Actions While Raising South's Demographic Concerns
p: Chandrababu Naidu has voiced his backing for the delimitation initiative while simultaneously highlighting demographic worries relevant to southern states. During a visit to the national capital, the leader affirmed his support for the central administration's policies.
Naidu stated that his trip to New Delhi was intended to demonstrate solidarity with the measures implemented by the central government under the guidance of Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

53364b875b.h: مقترح أوكراني لوقف إطلاق النار بالبحر الأسود لاستئناف تصدير الغذاء
p: أعلنت السلطات الأوكرانية، يوم الجمعة، عن تقديم مبادرة تقضي بوقف إطلاق النار ضمن نطاق البحر الأسود.
وتهدف هذه الخطوة إلى تمكين البلاد من إعادة إطلاق حركة صادراتها الغذائية، حيث تم إطلاع الحلفاء الدوليين على تفاصيل هذا المقترح.

44b9114ae4.h: صعود أسعار الذهب العالمية بنسبة 2% والأوقية تقترب من 3653 دولاراً
p: شهدت تعاملات اليوم الجمعة الموافق السابع والعشرين من نوفمبر لعام 2026 زيادة ملحوظة في قيم المعدن النفيس على المستوى العالمي.
وقد بلغت نسبة الصعود نحو اثنين بالمائة، ليقترب سعر الأونصة الواحدة من حاجز 3653 دولاراً.

19a69e3caa.h: Parents turn to 1970s tabletop game as screen-free solution for tweens
p: Frustrated by constant device usage, certain guardians have discovered an offline refuge through a classic role-playing activity that originated during the 1970s. This traditional pastime offers children who are approaching their teens an alternative to digital entertainment.

The tabletop adventure allows participants to engage in imaginative play without the use of electronic devices. Adults seeking relief from modern technology are increasingly embracing this decades-old gaming option for their youngsters.

8e05e0262a.h: Millions affected as cyber incident halts UK benefits and pensions
p: Millions of people have been cut off from vital pension and welfare systems following a digital security event. The Department for Work and Pensions announced that portions of its digital platform were intentionally disabled as a defensive measure.
The precautionary shutdown has temporarily blocked access for individuals relying on these government portals. Authorities have not yet detailed when full functionality will be restored.

5e8375a2ad.h: Main Suspect in Massive Chhattisgarh Liquor Scam Extradited From UAE
p: Vikas Agrawal, a primary suspect in a multi-billion rupee liquor scam in Chhattisgarh, has been returned from the United Arab Emirates. He was the subject of an active Interpol Red Notice.
Local law enforcement had registered the case regarding corruption within the state's alcohol supply network spanning the years 2019 through 2022.

4571de9aa2.h: Spanish PM and Opposition Leaders Make Final Push Ahead of Election
p: Spain's Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez is working to overcome current polling numbers as political leaders make their final appeals to voters. Sánchez is pushing to surpass predictions that show him trailing behind his opponents.

Meanwhile, the prime minister's primary political adversaries have launched sharp criticisms against him in the closing moments of the campaign. His rivals have publicly accused him of dishonesty and acts of betrayal as the electoral race concludes.

de1badddec.h: شيخ الأزهر يعزي محافظ القاهرة بوفاة والدته
p: قدم الإمام الأكبر الدكتور أحمد الطيب، شيخ الأزهر الشريف، التعازي والمواساة الخالصة إلى الدكتور إبراهيم صابر، محافظ القاهرة، إثر وفاة والدته.
وتوجه شيخ الأزهر بالدعاء إلى المولى عز وجل أن يتغمد الفقيدة بواسع رحمته ومغفرته، وأن يلهم أهلها وذويها الصبر والسلوان.

8852bb397a.h: Supreme Court to Review Trump Administration's Sweeping Asylum Restrictions
p: Recent large-scale immigration policy adjustments enacted by the Trump administration have nearly halted the asylum process entirely. These comprehensive modifications encompass an outright ban on asylum, widespread personnel terminations, and innovative legal tactics.

Advocates for immigrants are now turning their attention toward the Supreme Court in an effort to bring back the system. The nation's highest judicial body is poised to evaluate whether certain modifications deprive individuals of their constitutional right to due process.

9c175649cf.h: Court hears police found Chloe Mitchell's remains inside bins
p: During a court hearing, jurors learned that law enforcement officials located the remains of Chloe Mitchell inside containers.
Previously, the jury was informed that Brandon Rainey admitted to the killing of Chloe. However, he intends to use the partial defence of diminished responsibility.

7b01aa9ca0.h: Assam Police Busts Fake ICSE Certificate Scheme Involving Thousands
p: Authorities in Assam have apprehended three individuals in connection with a fraudulent scheme involving counterfeit ICSE certificates that affected approximately 4,900 students. The operation came to light following a formal complaint regarding the alleged creation and illegal use of Class 10 board examination records.

Law enforcement officials initiated the crackdown under a specific case registered at the CID Police Station. The ongoing investigation aims to uncover further details regarding the production and distribution of these falsified educational documents.

047bc055ef.h: تشلسي يسقط للمرة الثالثة توالياً في الدوري الإنجليزي ويضاعف الضغوط على ألونسو
p: تعرض نادي تشلسي لخسارته الثالثة على التوالي ضمن منافسات الدوري الإنجليزي الممتاز، وذلك يوم الجمعة.
وجاءت هذه الهزيمة عقب تفوق نوتنغهام فورست بثلاثة أهداف مقابل هدفين، بفضل ثنائية سجلها اللاعب مورغان غيبس وايت قادت فريقه لتحقيق الانتصار وزادت من الضغوط الملقاة على المدرب ألونسو.

1adad702e5.h: الدفاع المدني السعودي يعلن انتهاء الخطر في الشرقية والخرج
p: أكدت المديرية العامة للدفاع المدني في المملكة العربية السعودية انتهاء حالة الخطر بكل من المنطقة الشرقية ومحافظة الخرج.
جاء هذا الإعلان ضمن تنبيه رسمي نشرته الجهات المختصة عبر حسابها الرسمي على منصة إكس، وذلك بعد فترة قصيرة من إطلاق إنذار طارئ.

6a84da61ca.h: DWP Online Services Taken Offline Due to Cyber Incident
p: Virtually all digital platforms operated by the Department for Work and Pensions have been suspended following a cyber event.
The disruption has impacted critical online portals, affecting systems designated for pensions, universal credit, and personal independence payment submissions.

2b4214109c.h: NDA Falls Short Of Two-Thirds Majority In Lok Sabha Delimitation Vote
p: The central government's recent push for delimitation faced a setback on April 17, 2026, failing to secure the required majority in the lower house of parliament. During the session, 528 legislators cast their votes on the matter.

The ruling alliance garnered 298 supporting votes, while 230 lawmakers opposed the initiative. Because a two-thirds threshold of 352 votes was necessary for passage, the coalition ultimately fell short by a margin of 54 votes.

386fa551a1.h: German Parliament Adopts 2027 Federal Budget Plan
p: Members of parliament in Germany have successfully passed a federal spending plan for the year 2027 that carries significant financial debt. According to the approved legislation, total public expenditures will reach €556 billion.

In other domestic developments, the Left Party is currently organizing a gathering focused on the issue of femicide. Additionally, the political party BSW has commenced its scheduled conference taking place in Dresden.

22aa5aed5c.h: Manchester Police Tie Substance Release at Don Toliver Concert to Robberies
p: Law enforcement authorities in Manchester, England, indicated that a hazardous material released during a weekend musical event was connected to criminal activity. Investigators suspect that structured criminal elements deliberately focused on attendees within the audience to carry out multiple theft attempts.

The incident occurred on Sunday evening during the Don Toliver performance. According to local law enforcement, the deployment of the substance was part of a coordinated effort by wrongdoers to prey on individuals in the gathered crowd.

3e96703647.h: حصاد اليوم السابع: ثلاثون مليون جنيه تبرعات جديدة لمتضررى حادث الدائرى
p: عرض موقع «اليوم السابع» باقة من أبرز المستجدات والأحداث التي تهم المتابعين، مع تركيز خاص على الملفات الخدمية والحيوية خلال الأربع وعشرين ساعة الماضية.
وتضمنت التغطية الإخبارية الشاملة للموقع الإعلان عن تلقي تبرعات مالية إضافية بقيمة ثلاثون مليون جنيه مخصصة لدعم ومساندة ضحايا حادث الطريق الدائري.

3c02915390.h: Power Outages and Storms Force Thanksgiving Delays Across US
p: Severe weather and subsequent electrical failures forced several households in the United States to call off or delay their traditional Thanksgiving meals.
Instead of gathering on the holiday, celebrations were pushed to Friday, Saturday, and subsequent days as individuals waited for conditions and power to return to normal.

7ca2ac2eaf.h: Princess of Wales brought to tears by kids' voice messages in cancer film
p: During the Three Peaks Challenge, the Princess of Wales became visibly emotional while listening to audio notes sent by her children. Footage of the moment is featured in an upcoming documentary focusing on her cancer journey.
The newly announced film highlights the royal's health battle and captures the touching interaction as she wipes away tears during the challenge.

2414ef9c89.h: Assam Reports Over 6,000 Child Marriage Arrests Since 2021
p: Himanta Sarma revealed that authorities have detained 6,705 individuals in connection with underage marriage offenses since 2021. The statistics were made public to mark the inaugural International Day for the Elimination of Child, Early and Forced Marriage.
The administration emphasized that safeguarding the well-being and prospects of young females continues to be a major focus for the state.

5e9ab4e9fe.h: Egyptian Journalist Fights Censorship and Prison Threat
p: The future of independent journalism in Egypt faces a critical moment as reporter Lina Attalah and her publication, Mada Masr, battle through a pair of ongoing legal disputes. Observers view these court cases as a definitive test determining whether free press can endure in the nation.

Attalah remains committed to defending freedom of speech while simultaneously working to avoid imprisonment. The outcome of these legal challenges carries heavy implications for the survival of independent news organizations operating within the country.

9fa6354a68.h: جداول تشغيل قطارات القاهرة والإسكندرية اليوم السبت
p: أعلنت الجهات المعنية عن توفير جداول التشغيل الكاملة لرحلات السكك الحديدية بين العاصمة والإسكندرية في الاتجاهين، والمقرر إطلاقها اليوم السبت الموافق الثامن والعشرين من شهر نوفمبر لعام 2026.
وتأتي هذه الخطوة بهدف تسهيل تنقلات المسافرين وتيسير حركة السفر بين محافظات الوجه البحري بشكل منظم.

67bbfe18d8.h: Child Extortionist Sentenced for Forcing Girls to Injure Themselves
p: A judge has imprisoned Beau-Jack Mensforth following his conviction for blackmailing nine young girls into self-harming. The defendant targeted victims globally, with the youngest being just twelve years old.
Described during the legal proceedings as a cowardly monster, the offender preyed on the children across international borders before being brought to justice with a custodial sentence.

18012e7236.h: MK Stalin Accuses Vijay Of Escalating Deepam Controversy And Threatening Harmony
p: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister MK Stalin has directed sharp criticism at actor-turned-politician Vijay regarding the worsening situation surrounding the Deepam controversy. Stalin argued that the escalation poses a direct threat to communal harmony in the region.

The severe rebuke from the Chief Minister primarily focused on what he characterized as a dangerous surrender of hard-fought state rights. He also condemned the shifting of temple administration into a framework mandated via the Supreme Court.

c5a8ca76e6.h: France Seeks German Businessman Over Channel Migrant Smuggling Probe
p: French authorities are pursuing a German national suspected of providing gear to criminal networks facilitating illegal boat crossings from France to the UK. Before formal accusations can be brought against him, the suspect must be transferred to French jurisdiction.
The individual, identified as a businessman, is linked to the logistics behind the illicit channel crossings. Legal proceedings in France remain on hold pending his extradition.

fabf93c54f.h: حادث اصطدام بين طائرتين في مطار بواشنطن
p: شهد مطار رونالد ريغان في العاصمة واشنطن واقعة اصطدام بين طائرتين تنتميان لشركة "أميركان إيرلاينز".
وقعت الحادثة يوم الجمعة بينما كانت الطائرتان تتحركان على المدارج تمهيداً لبدء الرحلة.

b277dd9992.h: التقديرات الفلكية تحدد موعد بداية شهر رمضان لعام 2027
p: أوضحت البيانات الحسابية الصادرة عن الجهات الفلكية التوقيت المنتظر لحلول شهر رمضان المعظم لعام 1448 هجريا، والذي يقابل عام 2027 ميلاديا.
وتشير التوقعات إلى أن غرة شهر الصيام للعام الهجري المذكور سوف تكون في يوم الإثنين الموافق الثامن من شهر فبراير لعام 2027.

56823ed8f3.h: Wind Reveals Hidden Signage at Kennedy Center in Washington
p: A brief weather event in Washington briefly exposed the empty space where the former president's name previously appeared at the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts. Strong gusts blew away part of the material covering the removal site, drawing the attention of people in the capital for a brief moment.

89439e6919.h: Poundland enters administration after rescue efforts fail
p: Discount chain Poundland has entered administration following the failure of its American owners to arrange a rescue agreement.
The collapse of the budget retailer has sparked significant concern among both employees and customers regarding the future of the business.

f75fb13abb.h: Motorists Evading Tolls Face Hefty Penalties Beyond Standard Fee
p: Drivers attempting to bypass toll charges by concealing their vehicle's license plates could face substantial financial consequences. Authorities have established a fine system where motorists caught evading fees will be required to cover a penalty significantly higher than the standard rate.

For instance, an individual trying to avoid a standard one-hundred-rupee toll payment will ultimately face a total charge of six hundred rupees. This includes the original fee plus an additional five-hundred-rupee penalty applied on top of the initial amount.

0a5352e650.h: صدام حفتر يكشف عن جهود ليبية لتوحيد المؤسسات والسلطة
p: أفاد نائب القائد العام للجيش الوطني الليبي، صدام حفتر، مساء الجمعة، بأن البلاد تتقاطع نحو صياغة إطار عمل متكامل يهدف إلى جمع شمل مؤسسات الدولة والسلطة التنفيذية.
وجاء هذا الإعلان ليشير إلى مساعٍ جارية لتوحيد الجهود المؤسسية في ليبيا تحت مظلة واحدة.

dec985eba5.h: تفاصيل مواعيد رحلات قطارات تالجو الحديثة على السكة الحديد
p: تُعتبر قطارات تالجو الإسبانية ضمن أحدث وأسرع القطارات التي تقدم خدماتها عبر هيئة السكة الحديد، إذ تضمن لل مسافرين مستويات متقدمة من الهدوء والراحة.
وقد أعلن الموقع عن تفاصيل مواعيد هذه الرحلات المنتظمة على مختلف خطوط سكك حديد مصر.

c5246cab57.h: How High Court Rulings That Pleased Republicans Backfired Politically
p: Recent legal judgments concerning immigration, corruption, and voting rights initially brought celebration to the Republican party. However, these judicial outcomes ultimately sparked a strong voter backlash.
This surge in opposition significantly boosted voter participation, which played a crucial role in enabling Democrats to secure a sweeping victory across Congress.

9b59404c77.h: Flu Shot Advice Issued as Influenza Cases Rise
p: Medical authorities are strongly advising individuals to receive an influenza immunization as virus cases increase. This guidance raises questions for younger and healthier members of the public regarding whether they should also get inoculated during the current wave.

61043615c5.h: Jailed MP Amritpal Singh's Party Approaches Speaker and Centre for Parliament Access
p: Representatives for imprisoned parliamentarian Amritpal Singh have formally asked the Lok Sabha Speaker and the central government about his participation in upcoming legislative proceedings.

Amritpal Singh secured his seat during the 2024 parliamentary contests by running as an unaffiliated candidate, defeating rival Kulbir Singh Zira of the Congress party with a winning margin approaching two hundred thousand ballots.

8269f46967.h: الجيش الأميركي ينفي فرض رسوم إيرانية بمضيق هرمز
p: أكد الجيش الأميركي عدم صحة المزاعم الإيرانية المتعلقة بتحصيل رسوم مالية على السفن التي تُريد العبور من خلال مضيق هرمز.
وجاء هذا النفي القاطع ليضع حدّاً للتقارير التي تحدثت عن فرض تلك الجבايات البحرية في الممر المائي الحساس.

9b4a95e252.h: مشاركة واسعة بـ«اليوم السابع»: 95% من القراء يدعمون تشديد الرقابة المرورية لمواجهة السرعة
p: أظهر استطلاع صحفي نشره موقع «اليوم السابع» تفاعلاً ملحوظاً من جانب المتابعين حيال خطط ضبط حركة السير على الطرق.
وأعرب خمسة وتسعون بالمائة من المشاركين في التصويت عن مساندتهم لزيادة التواجد والحملات المرورية للسيطرة على قيادة المركبات بمستويات مفرطة من السرعة ومخالفة القواعد.

09630ca027.h: American Airlines Planes Touch Wings at Washington Area Airport
p: Two Boeing 737 aircraft made contact with each other while moving across the tarmac at the facility situated near Washington, D.C. The incident took place over the heavily traveled Thanksgiving holiday period.
Authorities confirmed that no people sustained injuries as a result of the wing collision.

1e357907d3.h: Princess of Wales's cancer battle and pensions cyber attack feature in Saturday's papers
p: Saturday's front pages are dominated by the Princess of Wales discussing her ongoing health journey regarding cancer, alongside a digital security breach affecting the pensions department.

f8ec75d28c.h: CSIR-UGC NET December 2026 Examination City Slips Released With Schedule
p: The official notification for the CSIR-UGC NET December 2026 examination indicates that the majority of applicants received their preferred test locations.
Specifically, 96.75 percent of test-takers obtained an exam city corresponding to one of their four selected preferences, while 91.90 percent successfully secured their primary choice.

d4f62329fa.h: Kashmir Rebels Evolve Despite Official Claims of Victory
p: Indian authorities have declared success after identifying the final local fighter in the region. However, experts point out that the separatist movement is not defeated.

According to analysts, the insurgency continues to push forward by altering its geography, titles, and operational methods, raising doubts about assertions that the rebellion has been completely dismantled.

1753ad05fc.h: السيطرة على حريق اندلع بميكروباص ومنافذ بيع في أكتوبر
p: نجحت قوات الحماية المدنية بمحافظة الجيزة في إخماد النيران التي نشبت داخل سيارة ميكروباص متوقفة بجانب منفذ بيع بمدينة أكتوبر، وذلك وفقا لما أظهرته الصور والتقارير الواردة من الموقع.
وقد نتج عن الحادث وقوع أضرار مادية لحقت بمحلين تجاريين يقعان بالقرب من مكان النيران، دون تسجيل تفاصيل إضافية حول الإصابات.

3b71dcf2c9.h: Planning Board Schedules Final Meeting on Trump Washington Projects
p: The National Capital Planning Commission has scheduled an eleventh-hour session to evaluate construction initiatives backed by President Trump. This upcoming gathering represents a final opportunity for the current administration to secure approvals for favored developments before a shift in congressional leadership.

Control over the planning agency is set to transition away from the president when Democrats assume power in Congress this coming January. Consequently, this immediate review session could grant definitive clearance to several high-priority projects associated with the outgoing administration.

f8878101f3.h: Pharmacies across England offer children flu vaccine for the first time
p: Pharmacies throughout England are now providing flu immunizations to thousands of children for the very first time. This initiative aims to reach youngsters who failed to receive their vaccine at school.
The rollout comes following a significant increase in hospital admissions. Over six thousand pharmacy locations are participating in the program to deliver the shots.

d2eb2e2ad1.h: CDS Flags National Security Concerns Over China, Pakistan, and Turkey Defense Ties
p: General NS Raja Subramani, the Chief of Defence Staff, has expressed concerns regarding potential security vulnerabilities stemming from the military cooperation between China, Pakistan, and Turkey.

According to the Defence Chief, Pakistan might obtain advanced Chinese technology and systems. This includes capabilities related to intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance, alongside positioning, navigation, and timing infrastructure.

571e9a7438.h: انفجارات وحرائق بناقلتي نفط جراء ألغام بحرية قرب مضيق هرمز
p: أعلنت القوات البحرية التابعة للحرس الثوري الإيراني عن وقوع اصطدام لناقلتي نفط بألغام بحرية في محيط مضيق هرمز، مما أسفر عن حدوث انفجارات واشتعال النيران فيهما.
وجاء هذا الإعلان عبر وسائل إعلام إيرانية رسمية، من ضمنها هيئة الإذاعة والتلفزيون.

fd98d9f911.h: Israeli Attack in Gaza Leaves Two MSF Employees Dead
p: An Israeli military strike in Gaza resulted in the deaths of two individuals employed by Doctors Without Borders.
While the military forces stated that the victims were associated with Hamas, Doctors Without Borders strongly denounced the military operation.

abe59a0f60.h: Washington Critics Shocked by Trump's Openness to Xi and Huang
p: Washington critics are expressing profound astonishment following Donald Trump's recent stance regarding Xi and Huang. This development has intensified concerns among hard-line voices in the capital.
These warnings have become increasingly pressing as certain observers characterize the situation as a winner-take-all competition for artificial intelligence supremacy.

ca8baf3106.h: Rescue Teams Search for 13 Missing Children and Staff in Bolu
p: Emergency responders in northwestern Türkiye have initiated a large-scale rescue effort following the disappearance of a vehicle in the Bolu province. Authorities lost all communication with the transport, which was carrying a group of ten children alongside three staff members.
Search operations remain active in the region as officials work to locate the missing individuals and determine the circumstances surrounding the loss of contact with the vehicle.

91621a00b2.h: Japan to Address Nuclear Submarine Debate in Upcoming Security Policy Updates
p: Japan is anticipated to advocate for discussions regarding nuclear-powered submarines as part of its upcoming national security document revisions.

According to the updates scheduled for release by the end of the year, the nation plans to outline its intent to initiate deliberation and ultimately determine a resolution concerning this sensitive topic.

ba67019f84.h: الداخلية المصرية توضح تفاصيل حادث الوراق على الدائري
p: أعلنت وزارة الداخلية في مصر، يوم الجمعة، عن ملابسات الحادث الأليم الذي وقع على الطريق الدائري في نطاق منطقة الوراق التابعة لمحافظة الجيزة.
وجاء هذا الكشف عبر مقطع مصور نشرته الجهات المعنية، ليبيّن تفاصيل وكيفية حدوث الواقعة المأساوية في المنطقة المذكورة.

f95bba0b83.h: إنذار عاجل من الأرصاد بشأن اضطراب الطقس بدءاً من الإثنين
p: أعلنت الهيئة العامة للأرصاد الجوية عن بدء موجة من الاضطرابات الجوية اعتباراً من يوم الإثنين الموافق ثلاثين من شهر نوفمبر الجاري.
وأوضحت الهيئة أن هذه الحالة غير المستقرة في الطقس ستؤثر على أجزاء مختلفة واقعة في شمال البلاد.

d96273e5b6.h: Saudi Air Defenses Destroy Houthi Cruise Missile Aimed at Riyadh
p: Saudi air defense forces successfully intercepted and destroyed an incoming cruise missile directed at the Riyadh area. The projectile was launched by the Houthi militia.
The operation was confirmed by Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Maliki, who serves as the official spokesperson for the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen.

b0c35f45d3.h: California Father Dies in 500-Foot Fall While Aiding Son on Mountain
p: A California hiking trip ended in tragedy earlier this week when a 44-year-old man plummeted approximately 500 feet to his death on Mount Baden-Powell, located northeast of Los Angeles. The victim, identified as Guillermo Batres, lost his footing as he attempted to assist his teenage son during the excursion.
Nearby witnesses stepped in to aid the young man following the accident. These two individuals successfully rescued the teenager and contacted emergency services by dialing 911.

4842cfc195.h: English Pharmacies Offer Flu Shots to Children Amid Surge
p: Pharmacies throughout England are now providing influenza immunizations to thousands of youngsters for the initial time. This rollout comes in response to a severe increase in illness rates.
