More than six thousand pharmacy locations are participating in the effort to administer the flu vaccines to the youth population.

06db81382d.h: ترامب يوجه اتهامات لإدارته بتزوير بيانات الاقتصاد تزامناً مع انتكاسة الجمهوريين
p: وجه الرئيس الأميركي دونالد ترامب اتهامات إلى فريقه الإداري بتعمد التلاعب في الأرقام الاقتصادية.
وجاءت هذه الاتهامات في أعقاب فترة وجيزة من انتخابات التجديد النصفي، والتي شهدت تعرض الحزب الجمهوري لخسائر ملحوظة.

59edda901e.h: Trump’s Retribution Campaign Fails to Deliver Expected Results
p: Donald Trump previously promised that a second presidential term would involve targeted retribution against political adversaries. However, these initiatives have largely failed to achieve their goals.
The administration and the Justice Department have encountered significant setbacks in these efforts, despite operating alongside a dedicated attorney general and an FBI director.

cae964761c.h: Saudi and Turkish Defense Chiefs Explore Closer Military Ties
p: During a gathering in Islamabad, Saudi Minister of Defense Prince Khalid bin Salman held discussions with Türkish National Defense Minister Yaşar Güler. The meeting took place alongside the second session of the Political and Defense Strategy Committee of the Makkah Alliance for Defense.
Both defense leaders praised the results achieved at the gathering and emphasized the necessity of expanding defense and military collaboration.

f8e8e7bf63.h: Former HMV Owner Eyes Acquisition of Historic High Street Brand
p: The entrepreneur from Canada who successfully saved the music retailer HMV seven years back is now preparing an acquisition offer for a prominent high street brand. The target company operated previously utilizing the WH Smith banner for a period exceeding two centuries.
This potential business move places the past HMV rescuer at the center of attention as discussions or plans regarding the takeover of the long-standing retailer continue to develop.

db855da6f0.h: Prime Minister Reaffirms Pledge To Women's Quota Legislation Ahead Of Parliament Session
p: The Prime Minister has stated that the administration remains dedicated to delivering on its commitment regarding the women's quota legislation.

This public statement emerged amidst a period of intense political developments focused on the upcoming special parliamentary session called for the following week, which is set to advance the delimitation bill.

ab2c82d90c.h: ضحايا بانفجار قرب مؤسسة تعليمية شرق أفغانستان
p: أسفر تفجير وقع قرب منشأة تعليمية في ولاية كونار الواقعة في الجهة الشرقية من أفغانستان عن سقوط عدد من القتلى والجرحى، حسبما أفادت تقارير أولية.
وأوضحت البيانات الأولية للحادث الذي ضرب منطقة أندر سير، عن ارتقاء سبعة من الدارسين إضافة إلى إصابة سبعة وتسعين آخرين بجروح مختلفة.

c4ea6bd011.h: توجيهات رئاسية بدعم أسر ضحايا ومصابي حادث الوراق
p: أفادت وزارة التضامن الاجتماعي بوجود متابعة مستمرة ومباشرة من الرئيس عبد الفتاح السيسي منذ وقوع حادث الوراق. وأصدر توجيهاته بتقديم كل صور الرعاية والدعم للمتضررين وأسر الضحايا والمصابين، بجانب صرف تعويضات عاجلة لهم.

72f6e69828.h: Saudi Arabia and Pakistan Explore Defense and Security Cooperation
p: Saudi Minister of Defense Prince Khalid bin Salman traveled to Islamabad to hold discussions with Pakistan's Chief of Army Staff and Chief of Defense Forces, Field Marshal Asim Munir. The high-level talks occurred during the second gathering of the Political and Defense Strategy Committee under the Makkah Alliance for Defense.

Both officials emphasized the crucial function the alliance serves in bolstering regional security and stability. Furthermore, they explored potential strategies to enhance joint defense capabilities between the two nations.

718995ead8.h: Captain Sir Tom Moore's Family Charity Seeks Dissolution
p: The charitable organization founded by the relatives of pandemic fundraiser Captain Sir Tom Moore has sought to be struck off the official register.
This move to dissolve the charity follows revelations of misconduct by the family.

1b0669c413.h: Sanjay Raut Criticizes Sharad Pawar's Power Bargain Over Delimitation Bill
p: Shiv Sena leader Sanjay Raut has sharply criticized Sharad Pawar's political strategy regarding the upcoming delimitation legislation. Raut characterized the Nationalist Congress Party leader's approach as compromising personal dignity.
Reports indicate that Pawar's faction is aggressively negotiating for significant governance positions at both the regional and national tiers in exchange for backing the boundary-adjustment measure.

a7161e8354.h: Explosion at Afghanistan Depot Leaves Seven Students Dead
p: An official spokesperson for the Afghan interior ministry reports that a blast near an explosives storage facility resulted in the deaths of seven students and left close to one hundred individuals hurt.
According to the ministry representative, the deadly incident was triggered by negligence at the nearby depot.

e3e6d38d01.h: فريق قانوني من التضامن لمساعدة أسر حادث الوراق
p: قامت وزارة التضامن الاجتماعي بتشكيل مجموعة قانونية متخصصة بهدف التسهيل على العائلات المتأثرة جراء واقعة الوراق.
وتتولى هذه المجموعة توفير كافة الأعمال القانونية بدون أي مقابل، فضلاً عن إنجاز استخراج الوثائق والاوراق الضرورية بشكل عاجل.

e44cf266a0.h: Al-Attiyah Triumphs at Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge as Quintero Makes History
p: Nasser Al-Attiyah secured his sixth victory at the Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge on Friday, marking his third consecutive win in the event. Meanwhile, Seth Quintero clinched the title of youngest FIA World Rally Raid Champion following an intense competition that concluded on the final stage in Al-Ain.
In the motorcycle category, Tosha Schareina successfully erased a deficit of nearly two minutes during the closing day of the competition.

59d0fa02ce.h: Millions of Kids Lose Food Stamps Under New Republican Policy
p: A domestic policy package advanced by Republicans has resulted in two million children losing their food stamp benefits. Proponents of the legislation argued that the reductions were necessary to eliminate fraud and encourage able-bodied adults to secure employment.
Despite the stated goals of the legislative changes, the policy has directly impacted a large population of minors by removing their access to nutritional assistance.

9a135e8bb7.h: Stalker Sent to Prison After Relocating to Live Near Victim
p: A stalker who changed his residence to stay in close proximity to the person he targeted has received a custodial sentence.
During the campaign of harassment, the offender, Hamza El-Hay, spent nearly eight hours waiting outside a property while his victim remained inside.
